description: Permission catalog of the AMU KPI Monitoring System. Single source of truth: route guards (config/permissions.js) and the seed (npm run seed:admin) read this file. A permission code is "<resource>:<action>". Every code here is enforced by at least one route; add a code here only together with the route or service check that uses it.

superAdmin.description: Wildcard: every permission, university-wide. Held only by the Super Admin role.

permissions.description: View the person directory and person profiles
Register new persons (optionally with a login account)
Edit person demographic and contact details
Delete persons (archived instead when referenced by records)
Provision accounts, activate/deactivate logins, reset passwords, view and revoke a user's sessions
Create offices under an office in scope
Rename, re-code, move or deactivate offices in scope
Define office types (university-wide only) and positions of offices in scope
Place persons into office positions (tenure, primary placement)
View roles, their permissions and the permission catalog
Create roles
Rename roles and change their permission set
Delete roles that have no active assignments
Grant or revoke office-scoped roles to office members

resources.label: Fiscal years, KPI catalog & master KPIs

permissions.description: Register master KPIs
Edit or retire master KPIs (only a few fields once a KPI is in use)
Manage fiscal years (create, activate, close; reopening is Super Admin only), strategic objectives, themes, units, frequencies, scales, currencies and exchange rates
View contracts, assignments, baselines, targets, weights and change requests in scope
Create contracts for subordinate offices, assign KPIs, set baselines, targets and weights, distribute responsibility
Approve or reject contracts and assignments, verify baselines, review change requests
Acknowledge assignments and sign contracts for the receiving office
Ask for clarification or request a correction of an approved assignment
Schedule evaluation cycles and move them through planned, open, in_review and closed
Start the draft report of an office for an open cycle
View report dossiers and their review history
Submit an office report for review (locks its evaluations)
Approve, reject or request changes on submitted reports
View reported and verified achievement values
Enter or update reported values for targets in an open cycle
Confirm actual values and finalize scores
View weighted office scorecards and theme scores
View the university-wide performance dashboard
Upload files
Download files (subject to confidentiality checks)
Register document metadata for uploaded files
Attach documents as evidence to evaluations, reports or targets, and remove links
View evidence attached to an entity
Dispatch notifications to offices (optionally sub-offices) or permission groups
View and change system settings
Query the audit trail
